handoffs.why: At the Yuan's dissolve (end of 1368) the compiler gives the Ming every Yuan cell inside Cliopatria's Ming 1375 shape (Inner Mongolia 3,590, Gansu 1,253, Liaoning 859, Jilin 681, Guizhou 676, Ningxia 198 and more: 7,860 cells that the Ming 1369 keyframe then takes back out, snap F032). Those lands were Ming only from 1370 to 1388.
